description: This file defines core interfaces and base classes for recognizers in the ANTLR parsing framework, including the Recognizer interface and the BaseRecognizer struct with associated methods.

classes.name: Recognizer
classes.description: Interface defining methods for recognizer implementations in ANTLR.

classes.name: BaseRecognizer
classes.description: Base class implementing common functionality for recognizers, including error handling, state management, and rule name retrieval.

methods.name: NewBaseRecognizer
methods.description: Constructor for BaseRecognizer, initializes listeners and state.

methods.name: checkVersion
methods.description: Checks if the runtime version matches the tool version.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: Sets the current recognition error.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Returns whether an error has occurred.

methods.name: GetError
methods.description: Retrieves the current recognition error.

methods.name: Action
methods.description: Placeholder method for actions, not implemented in base.

methods.name: AddErrorListener
methods.description: Adds an error listener.

methods.name: RemoveErrorListeners
methods.description: Removes all error listeners.

methods.name: GetRuleNames
methods.description: Returns the list of rule names.

methods.name: GetTokenNames
methods.description: Returns the list of token literal names.

methods.name: GetSymbolicNames
methods.description: Returns the list of symbolic token names.

methods.name: GetLiteralNames
methods.description: Returns the list of literal token names.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current recognizer state.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Sets the recognizer state.

methods.name: GetRuleIndexMap
methods.description: Method intended to return a map from rule names to indexes; not implemented.

methods.name: GetTokenType
methods.description: Method intended to return token type from name; not implemented.

methods.name: GetErrorHeader
methods.description: Returns a string with line and column info for an error.

methods.name: GetTokenErrorDisplay
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a token for error messages.

methods.name: GetErrorListenerDispatch
methods.description: Returns a proxy error listener that dispatches to all registered listeners.

methods.name: Sempred
methods.description: Stub for semantic predicate evaluation, always returns true.

methods.name: Precpred
methods.description: Stub for predicate evaluation before parsing, always returns true.
